name: Artem Makarov
source: Drummer of the band "Steklovata". Artem is chaotic and sloppy. He lives separately from his parents in a one-room apartment with his cat named Matvey. In his free time, he plays Dota 2. He has a rebellious character: once he poured yeast into the toilet and turned himself in to the principal for this. He thought that he would leave after the 9th grade, but his grades made him stay because he was not accepted anywhere, but he really doesn't care.
